description: Approve the final title, subtitle, front cover, back cover, marketplace description, and metadata.
Buy the domain that will be used for the website, companion page, and QR code destination.
Choose the publishing company or imprint name that will appear on the site and book materials.
Approve the simple site structure with a main brand home and a dedicated page for Health Fundamentals.
Decide whether to use a static site stack or managed WordPress, with security and portability as the priority.
Build the dedicated book page with the cover, promise, buy buttons, companion note, and future testimonials area.
Confirm the hybrid model with the website as the home base and Amazon as an optional buying path.
Choose the low-cost direct checkout and delivery setup for the website.
Pick the lightweight CRM and support flow for customer questions, order issues, and companion requests.
Choose the first simple automations for form intake, confirmations, customer tags, and companion access requests.
Write the rule for how the site will clearly disclose when a visitor is interacting with an AI assistant.
Approve the Health Fundamentals Companion Field Guide structure, size, naming, and delivery method.
Approve the opening note, how-to-use page, references and notes, appendices, and companion access note.
Tighten the opening note so it feels final-reader ready and bridges cleanly into Chapter 1.
Tighten the How To Use This Book page so it feels final-reader ready and clear.
Tighten the buyer-facing companion note and replace placeholders once the domain and access details are ready.
Decide how direct buyers and Amazon buyers will unlock the companion resource.
Choose the access word or code that retailer buyers will use to unlock the companion page.
Generate the QR code that points readers from the printed book to the companion page once the domain is live.
Decide whether to keep the manuscript concise or add more support material for stronger print presence.
Set the short URL, QR destination, and in-book wording that move retailer buyers to the website.
Keep the blender guidance brand-neutral and practical by budget, durability, cleaning, and use case.
Tighten the companion draft into final buyer language, including buying, washing, storage, filter, and reset guidance.
Finalize the retailer description, categories, and keyword language for marketplace upload.
Finalize the hero copy, calls to action, problem-solution message, and FAQ for the book page.
Confirm the hosting, SSL, access control, backups, and low-maintenance security approach before launch.
Turn the strategy into a simple step-by-step launch sequence.
Decide whether to launch a minimal journal first, then a mug later.
Plan the companion journal and refillable pen set so it supports notes, reflection, and the health journey without feeling expensive.
